'''Bith''' or '''Bithian''' was the native language of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] from [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. It was one of the official languages of the planet, the other one being [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]].<ref name="gorw" /> Biths learned to speak and write Basic at a young age, being bilingual. The Bith language was numerical in structure; a distress call sent by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] requesting an evacuation team translated to "Six-five. Twelve-seven-eight. Two-nine seven."<ref name="pot">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>
